title: session record
description: One lab session: `/var/lib/pinka/sessions/<boot_id>.json`, 0644 root, written once per boot by pinka-session-start.service (BUILD_PROMPT §7.16) and read by the platform's controller. A field that could not be computed is null, with the reason under errors.

boot_id.description: The kernel's boot ID (/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id); the file name.

fingerprint_hash.description: hash of the fingerprint; null if it could not be computed.

fingerprint.description: The environment fingerprint document (fingerprint.schema.json); null if it could not be computed.

preflight_outcome.description: Preflight's outcome at the session's start; null if preflight failed.

fingerprint.description: Why the fingerprint could not be computed.

errors.description: Why a field is null, by field.
